author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI allows just in time learning.

When Claude is slowly chunking out tokens to vibe code your app, you quickly ask ChatGPT explain to you whatever Claude had just proposed, since you absolutely have no idea what it is.

Don't ask Claude to teach you in the same Claude Code session, you will pollute the context window.   Use ChatGPT on the side is better.
